# Unity 2.0 / Valheon Command OS — Rise of Kingdoms (RoK) Intelligence & AI Calculator Platform

> Unity / Valheon is a full-stack Rise of Kingdoms (RoK) Kingdom Telemetry, KvK Wargaming, AI Vision OCR Calculator, and Tactical Commander Intelligence Platform. Backed by live scans of 139,000+ governor profiles and 1.17M historical snapshots across 12 native languages (`en`, `es`, `pt`, `fr`, `de`, `ru`, `zh`, `ko`, `vi`, `id`, `tr`, `ar`).

## Core Platform Capabilities & Routes

- **AI Vision Calculators (`/calculators`):** Speedup Calculator, VIP Level & Gem Planner, Equipment Forge & Material Calculator, Action Point (AP) Stash Calculator, Tome / Commander EXP Calculator, and MGE Score Planner—all powered by instant `Ctrl+V` Gemini Vision screenshot OCR.
- **Kingdom & KvK Analytics (`/analysis/kingdom`, `/analysis/kvk`, `/analysis/alliances`, `/analysis/players`):** Start-vs-End Delta DKP tracking, 8-dimensional behavioral vector analysis, SVD/PCA deadweight detection, hospital rebound forensics, and Hall of Heroes verified dead troop overrides.
- **Global Rankings & Seed Matchmaking (`/rankings`, `/tools/matchmaking`, `/tools/migration`):** Imperium / A / B / C / D Seed brackets, Top 300 Kingdom matchmaking power projections, and Migrant Passport calculators.
- **Tactical Commander & Meta Vault (`/guide`):**
  - **141 Commanders & 694 Skills:** Complete in-game skill multipliers, minimum viable investment benchmarks (`5511`, `5551`, `Max`), skill lock orders, formations (`Arch`, `Wedge`, `Delta`, `Hollow Square`, `Pincer`, `Triple Line`), accessories, and 74-point talent tree distributions.
  - **20 Stage-Aware Tier Matrices:** Validated pairings for `Season of Conquest (SoC)`, `KvK 2`, `KvK 1`, and `Pre-KvK` across `Open Field`, `Rally`, `Garrison`, `Swarming`, and `Sculpture Investment`.
  - **19 Multi-March Fleet Lineups:** Synergistic 5, 6, and 7-march open-field and swarming lineups with zero commander overlap.
  - **95 Field Guide Dossiers:** Comprehensive strategic playbooks covering Commanders, Events, KvK Tactics, Equipment Crafting, F2P Farming, and Spending ROI.
  - **Active Redeem Codes:** Verified Rise of Kingdoms gift codes with full reward breakdowns.

## Native 12-Language SSR Support

All routes are natively server-rendered with localized URL prefixes:
- English: `/en`
- Español: `/es`
- Português: `/pt`
- Français: `/fr`
- Deutsch: `/de`
- Русский: `/ru`
- 简体中文: `/zh`
- 한국어: `/ko`
- Tiếng Việt: `/vi`
- Bahasa Indonesia: `/id`
- Türkçe: `/tr`
- العربية (RTL): `/ar`
